company_policy.text:
This fictional company asks staff to state the requested action, name the responsible team where appropriate, and give a clear deadline. A direct request can be appropriate; qualification can be appropriate when information is incomplete.

Quoted complaints and reports of discrimination must retain attribution. The policy does not authorize employee rankings, emotional diagnoses or inferences about religious or political beliefs.
